title: OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results
key_facts: OpenAI is adding visual display ads to ChatGPT, so ads will appear alongside images that users ask ChatGPT to generate.
The new ads begin to appear later this month, in the US only for now, and feature products and services from an initial test group of advertisers.
OpenAI says the ads will be clearly labelled and will not influence the answers ChatGPT provides.
OpenAI introduced ads earlier this year to support its free and low-cost subscription tiers, and expanded them to India in August.
Once the ads roll out globally, advertisers will eventually be able to target ChatGPT's 1.2 billion weekly users.

OpenAI is also widening its ad measurement tools and partners: click-attribution partners now include AppsFlyer, Triple Whale, Adjust, Branch, Singular and Kochava among others, and Haus, Measured and WorkMagic help advertisers run geo-based experiments.
OpenAI is working on brand-suitability evaluation pilots with DoubleVerify and Integral Ad Science to help advertisers understand the ChatGPT ads environment.

TechCrunch's reading (not OpenAI's): the ads could disrupt the user experience and push casual users to pay for a subscription to avoid them; the move follows the launch of Meta's Muse, a free agentic AI app that is a growing rival to ChatGPT.
quote_evidence: Specifically, OpenAI is adding visual display ads to its ad product line-up so that ads will appear alongside images that users ask ChatGPT to generate.
The new ads will begin to appear later this month in the U.S. only for now, and will feature products and services from an initial test group of advertisers.
The ads will also be clearly labeled and won’t influence the answers ChatGPT provides, the company notes.
